content.title: Arkanoid MSM
about: A mobile arcade project inspired by the classic Arkanoid/Breakout formula, developed within the CITM Mobile Devices coursework repository.
Implements the core arcade gameplay loop (paddle, ball, breakable bricks) and focuses on a clean, playable prototype.
features: Classic Arkanoid-style loop: paddle control, ball movement, and breakable brick layouts
Score/lives style progression typical of arcade games
Built with C# plus ShaderLab/HLSL shaders (Unity stack inferred from languages)
learnings: Reinforced arcade game feel fundamentals (paddle control, pacing, and feedback).
Practiced shipping a simple, complete mobile gameplay loop with clean project structure.
